segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר, אזמען פועלט נאר מיט גיטין, אין אז ע"ס דווכט זיך אזמען האט מיט בייזין כוא גפועלט זוול מען ווייסין אז מיט גיטין וואלט מען אסאך מער גפועלט.
segments.en: During the controversy of the rabbi of Savran against Moharan'as — when they oppressed him greatly — Moharan'as answered and said: "Fun mir vet blaybn a shank [migdal] mit sforim — un fun zey vet blaybn a shank mit flesher" [From me will remain a tower of books — and from him will remain a tower of bottles]. And so it came to pass: from Moharan'as there remained a tower full of manuscripts — all of the Likutay Halachos and so forth. And from the other nothing remained except a tower with bottles — for he had been ill and drank wine continually, and a tower full of bottles remained — as is well known to all.
